description:
The Macha Core module is part of the Macha project, built on Clean
		Architecture principles to provide reusable components for
		enterprise-level applications. It encapsulates core business logic
		(Entities), application-specific use cases, and interface adapters while
		ensuring modularity, testability, and scalability. Technologies used
		include Java, Apache Maven, and Docker, offering flexibility for
		integration with frameworks like Spring Boot, databases, and cloud
		services.
